title: String Manipulation 1.0
statementMd:
One popular website developed an unusual username editing procedure. One can change the username only by deleting some characters from it: to change the current name $*s*$, a user can pick number $*p*$ and character $*c*$ and delete the $*p*$-th occurrence of character $*c*$ from the name. After the user changed his name, he can't undo the change.

For example, one can change name "`arca`" by removing the second occurrence of character "`a`" to get "`arc`".

Polycarpus learned that some user initially registered under nickname $*t*$, where $*t*$ is a concatenation of $*k*$ copies of string $*s*$. Also, Polycarpus knows the sequence of this user's name changes. Help Polycarpus figure out the user's final name.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ 2000$). The second line contains a non-empty string $*s*$, consisting of lowercase Latin letters, at most $100$ characters long. The third line contains an integer $*n*$ ($0 ≤ *n* ≤ 20000$) — the number of username changes. Each of the next $*n*$ lines contains the actual changes, one per line. The changes are written as "$*p*_{*i*}$ $*c*_{*i*}$" (without the quotes), where $*p*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ 200000$) is the number of occurrences of letter $*c*_{*i*}$, $*c*_{*i*}$ is a lowercase Latin letter. It is guaranteed that the operations are correct, that is, the letter to be deleted always exists, and after all operations not all letters are deleted from the name. The letters' occurrences are numbered starting from 1.

## Output

Print a single string — the user's final name after all changes are applied to it.

## Note

Let's consider the first sample. Initially we have name "`bacbac`"; the first operation transforms it into "`bacbc`", the second one — to "`acbc`", and finally, the third one transforms it into "`acb`".
statementZhMd:
某个热门网站采用了一种不同寻常的用户名编辑流程。用户只能通过从用户名中删除一些字符来修改用户名：若要修改当前名称 $*s*$，用户可以选择一个数字 $*p*$ 和一个字符 $*c*$，从名称中删除字符 $*c*$ 的第 $*p*$ 次出现。用户名修改后，用户无法撤销该修改。

例如，可以删除名称 “`arca`” 中字符 “`a`” 的第二次出现，将其修改为 “`arc`”。

Polycarpus 得知，某位用户最初注册时使用的昵称为 $*t*$，其中 $*t*$ 是字符串 $*s*$ 的 $*k*$ 个副本拼接而成的字符串。此外，Polycarpus 还知道该用户进行的一系列名称修改。请帮助 Polycarpus 求出该用户最终的名称。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 2000$）。第二行包含一个非空字符串 $*s*$，由小写拉丁字母组成，长度不超过 $100$。第三行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$0 ≤ *n* ≤ 20000$），表示用户名修改的次数。接下来的 $*n*$ 行每行包含一次修改操作。

每次修改以 "$*p*_{*i*}$ $*c*_{*i*}$" 的形式给出（不含引号），其中 $*p*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ 200000$）表示字符 $*c*_{*i*}$ 出现的次数，$*c*_{*i*}$ 是一个小写拉丁字母。保证所有操作都是合法的，即要删除的字母始终存在，并且执行完所有操作后，名称中不会被删除全部字符。字母的出现位置从 1 开始编号。

## 输出格式

输出一个字符串，即执行完所有修改后用户的最终名称。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例。初始名称为 “`bacbac`”；第一次操作将其变为 “`bacbc`”，第二次操作将其变为 “`acbc`”，最后，第三次操作将其变为 “`acb`”。
